findings.recommendation: Consider validating positive execution price and quantity and nonnegative filled quantity, while keeping position_qty signed. This is a hardening improvement; the current contract still bounds and structurally validates synthetic input.
findings.failure_mode: The scalar schema accepts finite numbers and decimal strings with negative signs for all scalar fields. As a result, semantically impossible values such as a negative execution price or fill quantity can be recorded as observations even though malformed structure is rejected atomically.
findings.evidence: src/domain/local-test-harness.ts:18-19 defines scalarSchema using finite numbers or signed decimal strings; the same scalarSchema is used for event price/qty, order qty/filled_qty, and position_qty at lines 25-35.
findings.requirement: Malformed or over-limit updates are rejected atomically.
